summary: With autoSubscribe=false, a live screen publication can have track=null after temporary thumbnail unsubscribe. Workspace discovery incorrectly required an attached track, hiding the stream button and screen choice. Discovery now uses an unmuted screenShareVideo publication; selection retains explicit subscription and shows connecting until the track arrives.

checks.name: Red/green macOS widget regression
checks.observation: A real RemoteParticipant publication without an attached track reproduced the missing Watch screen button before the fix. After the fix it appears, selection is requested and connecting replaces ended state.

checks.name: Spec traceability
checks.observation: Neither pwsh nor powershell is installed on this host. No requirements or contracts changed.

checks.name: Live macOS receiver playback
checks.observation: No voice join or broadcast initiated. Widget regression does not prove live media decoding or thumbnail delivery.

remaining: Verify an existing remote broadcast appears on updated macOS, opens and disappears after unpublish. Live acceptance remains open.
